children: SPIE will acquire a 76% stake in SAR ANLAGENBAU GmbH.
SAR ANLAGENBAU's Managing Director and Shareholder Arno Reisinger will co-invest in the business with a stake of up to 24%.
Headquartered in Hausmening, Austria, SAR ANLAGENBAU  is a leading provider of electrical engineering and automation solutions.
SAR ANLAGENBAU had revenues of 100 million euros  ($111.20 million) for the 2025/2026 fiscal year.
The closing of the transaction is expected to take place beginning of 2027 and is subject to customary closing conditions.
